narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Daily Vlog -> Hook -> Diet & Family -> Intense Exercise Montage -> Late Night Reward -> Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents Day 31 of a 100-day weight loss challenge. It aims to show the creator's daily life, balancing family time and healthy eating with high-intensity peer-motivated group exercise. It uses a relatable vlog format to build engagement and accountability for his fitness goal.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear and frequent framing of 7-Eleven Taiwan products, specifically focusing on the 'Simple-fit' bento series and '御飯糰' as weight-loss-friendly options.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing style with frequent text variety and fast cuts. High reliance on group peer pressure as a motivational narrative theme.
